extDesc.message: Self-learning AI ad blocker. Blocks known ad networks instantly, learns new ones in the background. Bring your own API key.

keyWarn.message: No API key set — only the basic blocklist is active.

optIntro.message: Pick your AI provider and paste your own API key. The key stays in your browser — it is only ever sent to the provider you choose.

optSavedNoKey.message: Saved. No key for the selected provider yet — only the basic blocklist will run.

optTestNoKey.message: Enter a key for the selected provider first.

optTestOk.message: Key works — AI classification is ready.

sec1.message: Your API key is stored only in this browser (chrome.storage.local). It is never synced, logged or shared — the extension has no backend server.

sec2.message: The key is sent exclusively to the official API of the provider you selected, over HTTPS, and only to classify ad domains. No browsing history is collected.

sec3.message: Sentinel is fully open source — every line of code can be audited.
